QuestInfo.name: [Neo Tokyo] Harbinger of the End
QuestInfo.0: You've devastated the #o9601830# force, but now there's another threat: a man, possessed of unknown power, who's bypassed every one of the command center's defenses. No one here can stop him -- but you can.
QuestInfo.1: The stranger radiates power, intensely strong even by the standards you've come to know in Maple World. Where could he have learned that power?
QuestInfo.2: You faced the stranger in the command center, and drove him off for the moment. Did his powers come from Maple World? #p9401533# might know. Go back to #m802000101# and ask her.
